interests.notes: 2.0% NSR on the mine + surrounding AOI; operator First Majestic Silver Corp.; part of the Santa Elena complex; producing since Q4 2021. FY2025 mine-level: 1,101,613 t @ 62 g/t Ag / 2.65 g/t Au (recoveries 65% Ag / 94% Au). Dec 31, 2025 mine-level reserves: 4,310 kt @ 35 g/t Ag, 1.37 g/t Au (4,790 koz Ag / 190 koz Au); M&I 8,880 koz Ag / 380 koz Au; Inferred 24,190 koz Ag / 670 koz Au incl. Navidad vein (discovered Jul 2024, within AOI).

SOLD: 1.0% NSR acquired by Triple Flag Precious Metals via plan of arrangement closed Jul 9, 2025 (~C$421M for 201,961,675 shares of predecessor). Operator AngloGold Ashanti NA. Listed for continuity.
